meta.title: 《小丑》拉片完整版-上集
meta.title_en: Joker: A Full Scene-by-Scene Breakdown, Part 1

scenes.context: 导演是电影最终质量的第一责任人，除了喊Action和卡，在内容层面还要做好很多工作。
sentences: 导演是质量第一责任人。
The director owns the film's quality.
内容层面要做好很多工作。
There's much content work beyond calling action.
paraphrase: The director owns the film's quality.
There's much content work beyond calling action.
scenes.speak: The director owns the film's quality. There's much content work beyond calling action.

scenes.context: 《小丑》2019年拿到威尼斯电影节金狮奖，是第一部也是唯一一部获得金狮奖的漫改电影。
sentences: It won the Golden Lion in 2019.
唯一获金狮奖的漫改电影。
The only comic-book film to do so.
paraphrase: It won the Golden Lion in 2019.
The only comic-book film to do so.
scenes.speak: It won the Golden Lion in 2019. The only comic-book film to do so.

scenes.context: 如何让主角一出场就给观众留下印象：先给远景背影看不到脸，再特写化妆的手，胃口渐渐被吊起来。
sentences: Start with a back view, no face.
paraphrase: Start with a back view, no face.
scenes.speak: Start with a back view, no face. Close-ups build the suspense.

scenes.context: 侧面大特写还是看不到全貌，切到镜子里的近景由虚到实，最后正面脸部大特写终于看清。
sentences: End with the full face close-up.
paraphrase: End with the full face close-up.
scenes.speak: Go from blurry to sharp. End with the full face close-up.

scenes.title_en: Hear Them Before You See Them
scenes.context: 介绍关键人物时不见其人先闻其身或先见其行，以引起观众注意，是最基本的描述手法。
sentences: Hear the person before seeing them.
paraphrase: 用hear before seeing换一种说法
Hear the person before seeing them.
scenes.speak: Hear the person before seeing them. It's a fundamental storytelling device.

scenes.context: 电影里通过镜头运动、光线和构图来表达情绪，每个画面都有它的视听语言功能。
sentences: Light and composition serve the story.
paraphrase: Light and composition serve the story.
scenes.speak: Camera moves express emotion. Light and composition serve the story.

scenes.context: 一部烂片被骂，往往是最基础的镜头语言和叙事逻辑出了问题，连「让人记住主角」都没做到。
sentences: Bad films fail at the basics.
They don't even make the lead memorable.
paraphrase: Bad films fail at the basics.
They don't even make the lead memorable.
scenes.speak: Bad films fail at the basics. They don't even make the lead memorable.

scenes.context: 通过拉片拆解优秀电影的技术细节，才能找到「好电影为什么好」的答案。
sentences: Break the film down shot by shot.
paraphrase: 用shot by shot换一种说法
Break the film down shot by shot.
scenes.speak: Break the film down shot by shot. Find why great films work.
